entries.basis: Three original first-generation Windows Mixed Reality assessments: Ben Lang / Road to VR (October 19, 2017), Ian Hamilton / UploadVR (November 7, 2017), and Hayden Dingman / PCWorld (May 11, 2018). All tested Acer AH101 reference-design hardware, so hardware-specific findings are not asserted for every launch brand or Samsung Odyssey. Excerpts concern Microsoft inside-out tracking and its limitations. PCWorld tested again after April 2018 Windows/SteamVR support, not the exact October 2017 launch software; its later date is retained. These are immersive VR headsets, not HoloLens-style see-through AR. Distinct publications offer differing assessments; sentiment estimates describe short passages, not converted ratings.
